fusions.name: Puffball Hex
fusions.desc: Puffs a short cone of arcane spores 3 tiles ahead that deals 3 damage to everything caught, with a 25% chance of [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sporangium Burst
fusions.desc: Launches a pod of arcane spores that deals 30 damage and bursts over every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that, leaving them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Glowcap Circle
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to raise a ring of glowing caps beside you for 15 seconds. It casts at enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Bloom
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack of arcane spores builds on that enemy, up to 5. When it reaches 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
